description: Fetch dimension definitions and valid coded values for a Moldova Statbank PxWeb table. Path must end in the '.px' table id (e.g. '20 Populatia si procesele demografice/POP010/POPro/POP010100rcl.px'). Returns dimensions with codes and value lists — use these to build the selection body for query_table.
name: statbank_md_table_meta
title: Statbank Md Table Meta
